review_scope: Plugin Host public contracts, exact admission and trust closure, Wasmtime/WIT isolation, Host-managed service UDS identity, lifecycle/fencing, statistics finalization, bounded resources, TLS, process/OCI boundary, supply chain, performance and formal-soak evidence

findings.title: The sixth independent deployable module and its Manager-facing boundary did not exist
findings.resolution: Implemented a deny-by-default Rust Host with exact Manager mTLS identity, immutable binding admission, Wasm Component and explicit service runtime registries, public lifecycle/readback APIs and a non-root immutable OCI image.

findings.title: Initial lifecycle state prevented safe same-generation transitions and side-by-side definition activation
findings.resolution: Separated immutable admission subject from refreshable lifecycle/freshness control, added explicit shadow execution, active-only statistics definition routing, atomic new-generation activation, old-generation draining and late-result fencing.

findings.title: Default transport configuration did not prove TLS 1.3-only negotiation
findings.resolution: Replaced implicit TLS defaults with an in-process Rustls TLS 1.3-only acceptor, mandatory client CA validation, exact leaf DER digest authorization, a two-second handshake bound and bounded connections/streams; plaintext, TLS 1.2 and wrong-leaf negatives are exercised.

findings.title: Cancelled queue wait could leak a per-binding queued counter
findings.resolution: Made queue admission an RAII guard so cancellation, timeout and early error all release the exact counter; total deadline now includes queue time and the manifest queue ceiling is enforced.

findings.title: Raw plugin output deduplication did not preserve the final statistics Artifact bytes
findings.resolution: Added a bounded final-reply idempotency cache keyed by the exact public request digest so an exact run replay returns byte-identical Artifact/provenance while changed input, fence or trace is a stable conflict.

findings.title: A long multibyte diagnostic could panic while being truncated
findings.resolution: Property testing exposed a non-character-boundary byte truncation; the public error constructor now walks to a valid UTF-8 boundary while preserving the 512-byte ceiling and the generated regression seed is retained.

findings.title: Admission-time trust validation alone could outlive the five-minute freshness ceiling
findings.resolution: Every new invocation now checks current binding expiry and revocation observation age; monotonic same-generation refresh updates only bounded control freshness while immutable artifact/config/capability identity remains fixed.

findings.title: A delayed refresh for an older generation could move the active pointer backward
findings.resolution: Made ordinary activation generation-monotonic, rejected stale lower-generation refreshes before control mutation, and added an explicit authorized RollbackBinding request with exact current-generation CAS fencing. The release black box proves stale refresh rejection, controlled rollback, late-generation fencing and subsequent monotonic roll-forward.

findings.title: The first passing runner summary accepted named scenarios without sufficient behavioral oracles
findings.resolution: Independent post-run review withdrew the premature completion claim. The gates now require structured fault evidence, real over-capacity rejection, separate Wasm compile/cold/warm measurements, resource trends, service crash/restart recovery and exact Go contract-consumer checks; old runs remain immutable and a new full run is required.

findings.title: Statistics routing bound only a definition ID and decoded a non-contract input subset
findings.resolution: Bindings and manifests now carry exact definition ID/revision/digest; active routing compares all three. Frozen input matches the strict public record, binds producer/source/scope/window/budgets, recomputes semantic and full-bundle digests, shares a golden, and rejects changed definition revision/digest before projection.

findings.title: Fault, queue saturation and cold/warm performance gates did not execute their claimed scope
findings.resolution: Added actual hang/trap/wrong-digest/oversize/cancel/crash/disable/drain/reconcile/quarantine tests, a structured fault matrix, 128-call slow-consumer saturation with typed rejection and zero-leak oracle, three benchmark trials with warmup, separate Wasm compile/cold instantiate/warm execution, and formal-soak service crash/restart plus queue/in-flight/connection trends.

findings.title: The strict manifest omitted mandatory artifact, contract, ambient capability, compatibility and lifecycle fields
findings.resolution: Manifest and Rust admission now bind plugin revision, artifact digest/media/entrypoint/platform, Host/kind/config contracts, skills/MCP/A2A/network/preopen/secret declarations, statistics definitions, extended resource budgets, verification/owner/support, rollback compatibility, lifecycle/fallback and observability. Missing/unknown fields and Host API drift fail closed.

findings.title: Lifecycle actions lacked full audit/CAS identity and revoke ignored service disable failure
findings.resolution: Drain/revoke now require operation, actor, reason, authorization and expected-envelope CAS; revoke fences immediately but returns bounded disable failure instead of false success. Service drain/disable deadlines are enforced, and a fixed 30-second local trust reconciler stops stale staged/shadow/active bindings without inventing canonical facts.
